roles_meaning_base: The person underneath who holds others up. Use it when you don't want to tell primary, side and shoulder stand bases apart.
roles_meaning_main_base: The base who mainly holds the top person's feet. In a single-based stunt, the one base.
roles_meaning_side_base: In a multi-based stunt, the base who holds alongside the primary base.
roles_meaning_shoulder_base: In a pyramid, the base on the ground with a middle layer standing on their shoulders. Pyramids only.
roles_meaning_top: The person held up off the ground by bases. “Top person” on its own means someone held by bases who isn't holding anyone else.
roles_meaning_middle: In a pyramid, the person standing on bases while holding up a third layer.
roles_meaning_third: In a pyramid, the person at the very top, standing on a middle layer. Pyramids only.
roles_meaning_bracer: In a pyramid, a person who is held up too and reaches out to steady another top person.
roles_meaning_spotter: Stands beside the top person to protect them. May hold ankles, lower legs or knees, but not under the feet. Not a base.
roles_meaning_front_spot: The spotter in front of the top person.
roles_meaning_back_spot: The person behind the top person, in both stunts and basket tosses.
roles_meaning_catcher: The person who catches a top person who falls or is tossed.
roles_rule_third: Top person on the top level
records_not_yet: — means this rep didn't have this phase yet
